scientific_integrity: Complete proof of finite-dimensional sharp universal claim and exact-rational auxiliary checker; computational examples are not used as proofs of universal real-parameter statements.
scientific_limitations: Rank-one real 1-by-5 matrices with nonzero columns, exact without-replacement size-two volume sampling; no high-dimensional or approximate-sampling theorem. Historical priority has residual uncertainty and there has been no independent validation.
title: A sharp three-regime tail law for two-column volume sampling
